text:
jordan_support: Heads up — Neurolytics just filed a priority issue after the onboarding run. Embeddings from our hosted API are returning high false-positive matches for their similarity index, plus they hit a provisioning quota when we tried to bump capacity. Support flagged renewal risk for next month. Need CS takeover + comms plan.

devon_support: adding logs and error snippets below. Error rate spike started ~1729008000. Their index id: nl-2025-prod

jordan_support: @mira_cs_lead can you own the outreach? Recommended: 1) triage call w/ tech PM 2) temporary quota bump 3) alignment email to exec sponsor. I can patch them to our SRE retainer for the quota.

mira_cs_lead: I can take it. Sam, are you free for a 30m call in next 2h? We should confirm business impact + ask for sample prompts.

sam_csm: I can at 11:30 PT. I'll pull the renewal timeline and current usage. Prep TODOs: collect example mismatches, ask for ingest date ranges, capture account contact list.

jordan_support: Quick note: SRE can run a KV cache flush and reindex a subset. Want to run while we have them on call? Ops can do a temporary +20% quota for 72h.

mira_cs_lead: Yes. Ops @ops_bot can you approve a 72h quota bump for nl-2025-prod and notify billing for tracking? Mark as 'support->cs emergent' so billing doesn't auto-invoice.

ops_bot: @mira_cs_lead Quota bump request received. Approved for 72h. Ticket #INC-72234. Billing notification queued.

devon_support: Pasting sample logs and minimal repro below:
```
[2025-04-05 10:40:12 UTC] request id=abc123 model=redwood-embed-v1 latency=210ms status=200 matches=12 expected=3
payload: {"query":"patient symptom list...","top_k":5}
```

sam_csm: Ok I'll send the initial outreach email draft to their sponsor. I'll include the ask for a shared prompt set so we can run a controlled eval. Mira, please confirm call time and send calendar invite with tech and SRE.

mira_cs_lead: Draft invite sent for 11:30 PT. Agenda in invite. I'll own post-call notes and the comm plan. Jordan — can you add a short "what we changed" blurb for customers? Need a one-paragraph explanation for execs.

jordan_support: On it. Draft blurb: "We observed elevated similarity mismatches for a subset of inputs after ingestion. We've temporarily increased capacity, queued a reindex for the affected index, and will run a controlled evaluation with your sample prompts to validate fixes. We'll follow up within 48 hours with results and next steps." :thumbsup: 

sam_csm: :thumbsup: Also capturing feedback loop: add a follow-up survey link and ask for a contact for weekly sync until renewal.

mira_cs_lead: Action items assigned in the invite. Post-call I'll create a comms doc in Docs (link in thread) and assign to Stella for ongoing enablement sessions. Everyone, please react with :eyes: when you've read the invite.

devon_support: Reacted. I'll be on the call and will keep live logs open.

mira_cs_lead: Thanks team. I'll update thread after call with comms doc link and next steps.
